name: scan-exclusion
body: A path excluded from discovery because it holds generated, dependency, or other-tree content: target/, vendor/, node_modules/, .worktrees/. Exclusions keep build artifacts and dependency crates from becoming scan roots. The Python frontend adds the Python-specific exclusions __pycache__, .venv, venv, .tox, .git, .hg, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache, .ruff_cache, .eggs and *.egg-info (domain.constraint.python-exclusions).
